title: Row-chevron phrasings compose recipe/row-actions, not bulk-actions

review.applied: none required; advisory watch item noted

problem: The row actions chevron ("the chevron that reveals actions for a single row") composes recipe/bulk-actions, which is about batch operations in the selection bar. The correct neighbour recipe/row-actions exists, describes exactly the .menu-pop row-menu pattern, and simply does not match this phrasing.
